text: Captain Jytte was a famous privateer. She was said to have been High King Erling's lover, as they both met in secret various times, though such rumor was never proved.
Captain Kaleen is a Redguard residing in Port Hunding in Stros M'Kai. Captain Kaleen is responsible for saving the Vestige from drowning, if they sided with the Daggerfall Covenant.
Candariel is a Bosmer brewer who resides in the city of Port Hunding on the island Stros M'Kai. She can be found at her stall, Brews by Candariel near the docks, selling beverages.
Captain Irinwe is a Maormer captain on the island of Khenarthi's Roost. She captains the Serpent's Kiss, and is very possessive of who comes aboard.
Canonreeve Valano is an Altmer, and the acting Canonreeve of the town of Silsailen, on the island of Auridon.

Camoran Kaltos was a tactician in the Valenwood Military, known for his clever battle tactics. He was also a close friend and associate of Haymon Camoran, who was also known as the Camoran Usurper. Most likely, Kaltos was the leader of Valenwood's military forces, or a special branch thereof. Haymon, later known as the "Camoran Usurper," served as sorcerer and advisor to Lord Kaltos.

Captain Aresin is an officer of the king's guard. He resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found north of the Daggerfall Castle. He appears to be in charge of the protection of the king, and it is with the him the Vestige corresponds during the Blood and the Crescent Moon questline.
Captain Farlivere is a Breton captain of the Daggerfall Guard in . She has sent her soldiers to the house taken over by the Red Rook Bandits to try and free the hostages they have looked inside.
Camille Guylitte is a Breton residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She has a stall at the Lionguard Camp Market, where she sells her wares.
Camille Ashton is a Breton enchanter with her own shop at Tradesman's Square.
Calenethel is a Bosmer laborer residing in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard.
Captain Erronfaire is an Altmer who resides in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard.

Captain Gilame is a Redguard Captain from the Lion Guard, found near the Farwatch Tower, Glenumbra, in . She is leading the defense of the tower and the Vestige can help her take out the fires if they have offered their assistance.

Canonreeve Malanie is an Altmer noble who rules the town of Mathiisen, Auridon, a town known for producing some of the finest steel in all of the Dominion. She is also an officer in the Altmer supremacist group the Veiled Heritance, and has used her position to supply the organization with weapons and armor. Almost all her high-ranking members and guards are part of the Heritance. After an investigation into Malanie, the Vestige is sent by Razum-dar to arrest her as a diversion. Though she has the Vestige knocked out and arrested, she is killed in a fight against the Vestige and Razum-dar. Shortly after her death, the town falls completely into the hands of the Dominion.
Calabenn is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.

Camarino is an Altmer farmer residing in Phaer, Auridon. Camarino is in charge of collecting letters from family members of the plagued and passing them on to the quarantine. He is the author of the letter Letter from Camarino.
Caldandien is an Altmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Captain Halakalal is a Khajiit and the head of security at the Redfur Trading Post.
Captain Binlay is a Breton Captain who resides in Glenumbra, High Rock. She can be found outside Lion Guard Redoubt.
Camlorn Volunteer is a Breton who resides in Glenumbra. She takes part in the quest "The Fall of Faolchu" in Camlorn.
Cahusque Coutenan is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He is found inside the Temple of the Divines. He is representing Dibella.
Capiton Popillius is an Imperial assassin and one of the three assassins sent to eliminate Falco Galenus.
Captain Henriel is a Bosmer captain from the stranded Dominion Fleet. She resides at the Temple of the Crescent Moon in the region of Khenarthi's Roost.
Captain Landare is an Altmer captain of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is found in the city of Dawnbreak on Auridon.
Canonreeve Sinyon is an Altmer residing in the city of Dawnbreak, in Auridon.
Camaldetuile is an Altmer mage found in Ezduiin, an ancient Ayleid Ruin, where she is a student of Telenger's.

Camandar is an Maormer member of the Sea Vipers found in the ruins of Bewan, in the top right corner of the map. He is the author of a journal regarding his attempts to take a powerful crystal from a group of Altmer.
Captain Hjolm is a Nord part of the Ebonheart Pact and the commanding officer of Fort Arand.
Calastil is an Altmer residing in the city of Marbruk. He is married to Tarie and is spends most of his time reading inside his house.
Caitarius is an Imperial backpack merchant and a member of the Mages Guild. He sells his wares at the Guild Vault and Baggery on Eyevea.
Caesonia is an Imperial member of the Seventh Legion in . She is found at the ruins of Nilata, Bangkorai, where she has been trapped by spiders.
Calanyese is an Altmer member of the Veiled Heritance hiding out at Beacon Falls.
Caldartur is an Altmer member of the group of outlaws found underneath Velyn Harbor.
Calixte Gevette is a Breton residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven.
Calls-to-Nature is an Argonian bandit found in the ruin of Sheogorath's Tongue, Stonefalls.
Calpelion is an Altmer clothier and member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood. He can be found at the forge at the local branch, selling his wares.
Calpion is an Altmer found in Mistral. He was attacked by Sea Vipers, and his bodyguard was heavily injured during it.
Cambio Gestor is a Breton mystic and owner of The Arcane Shop in Riften.
Camyaale is an Altmer guild trader offering her wares at The Marbruk Mart, in Marbruk.
Candion is a member of the Fighters Guild found in the hall in Vulkhel Guard. She is overlooking a training of some recruits.
Caniel is an Altmer armorer selling her wares at the Artisans Alley, in Dune.
Canirne is an Altmer member of Queen Ayrenn's entourage found camped just outside the ruins of Tanzelwil. She stands next to Elantelle and has no unique dialogue.
Canollot Geric is a Breton mage of the Mages Guild in who stands as the Magister of the Vulkwasten Mages Guildhall in Vulkwasten.
Captain Alhana is a Nord warrior trying to solve the ongoing problem in Kynesgrove.

Captain Angarthal is the Dunmer shipmaster of The Bloody Scupper and a prominent member of the Ember-Eye Slavers. Him and his crew have kidnapped Captain Albert Marck's crew, thus leading the latter seeking the Vestige's aid.
Captain Attiring is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. She is tasked with routing out the Boneshaper Reachmen from the Shor's Stone mine.
Captain Aurelia Blasio is an Imperial and the leader of the Gold Coast Mercenaries that were hired by the Khajiit of the Baandari Trading Post.
Captain Bernardine is the leader of a Daggerfall Covenant contingent currently pursuing a couple of traitors hiding out inside North Beacon.
Captain Candidus is an Imperial officer in charge of the Seventh Legion forces found in Yldzuun.
Captain Carlier is a Breton boatswain found at the Sentinel Docks. She sails passengers from Sentinel to Wayrest.
Captain Ciranya is the Aldmeri Dominion officer in who is in charge of her unit stationed at the South Beacon. When the Beacon was ransacked by the Sea Vipers, she was captured.
Captain Cirenwe is an officer of the Aldmeri Dominion tasked with finding an ancient Aldmeri defense system designed to protect the nearby town of Greenwater Cove.
Captain Cularalda is the leader of the Fists of Thalmor contingent posted in Velyn Harbor. After the Daggerfall Covenant assault on the town, she was found hiding under the docks and arrested.
Captain Diiril is a Dunmer soldier of House Hlaalu. He is currently investigating the curse of the Obsidian Gorge.

Captain Dugakh is an Orsimer member of the Murtag Clan currently fighting the Ironhand Ogres in Shinji's Scarp. He asks the Vestige to kill ogres and retrieve their teeth to make him a war trophy to bring back to the stronghold.
Captain Dunveril is a Dunmer and the leader of the House Indoril forces found in Vanguard Camp, near Kragenmoor.
Captain Eilram is a member of the Fighters Guild imprisoned in the Tower of Lies.
Captain Ernele is a Breton member of the Wayrest City Guard who has been tasked with supervising the city's newly installed guillotine.
Captain Eugien Gaercroft is a Breton captain of the Lion Guard. He is currently trying to force the Dark Witnesses out of the farm of Northglen, and thus put an end to their operations.
Captain Falkwind is an officer of the Daggerfall Covenant who took control over the Sulfur Pools.
Captain Farys is a Dunmer member of the House Indoril forces found in Kragenmoor. She is found patrolling the barracks in the city.
Captain Gemelle is an Imperial officer of the Seventh Legion in . She is found at the ruins of Nilata, Bangkorai, where she is looking for her missing soldiers.
Captain Gogbag gro-Yashna is a member of the Shornhelm Guard.
Captain Gorblad gro-Yashna is a member of the Shornhelm Guard.
Captain Graalug is an Orsimer soldier posted at the Bangkorai Gate.
Captain Gwyssa is a Breton captain of the Lion Guard investigating the situation in Eagle's Brook.
Captain Hamar is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. He has been tasked with regaining control of Fort Morvunskar, in the hold of Eastmarch.
Captain Helenus is an Imperial member of the Seventh Legion found at the Old Tower. Her and her men are responsible for the death of Captain Wardush's squad.
Captain Henaamo is an Altmer officer of the Aldmeri Dominion who may be in the ruins of Hissmir in Shadowfen. He is currently undertaking the Trials of the Hist.
Captain Hjurrun is the Nord head of the Evermore City Guard.
Captain Hrosta is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. She is tasked with getting the Worm Cult out of Arcwind Point.

Captain Janeve is a Breton, the younger sister of Countess Eselde Tamrith and the head of the Shornhelm City Guard. She is currently tracking the treacherous Reezal-Jul while tending to the refugees coming from Crestshade. After learning the exact position of Reezal-Jul, she goes after him into his lair. Unfortunately, after engaging him in battle, she was turned into a vampire.
Captain Jardirr is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact in .
Captain Jurard is the leader of a contingent of Daggerfall Covenant soldier who attacked Heimlyn Keep.
Captain Khala is a Nord soldier working for House Montclair. She is tasked with coordinating the troops outside Northpoint.
Captain Khammo is a blind pirate trying to gain access to Anvil.
Captain Linwen is the Altmer former captain of the Albatross, whose crew led a mutiny against her to search for treasure in the Cave of Broken Sails.
Captain Llaari is a Dunmer soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. She is the commanding officer of Fort Arand.
Captain Lucius is a member of the Wayrest City Guard. He is awaiting a report of the ongoing situation in the Wayrest Sewers.
Captain Elonthor is a Bosmer in . He is an officer of the Aldmeri Dominion and is overseeing the situation happening in Southpoint.
Captain Arame is an undead skeleton found at Castle Rilis in Auridon.
Captain Anatolius Caudex is an Imperial captain and a member of what remains of the Imperial Legion. He can be found in the Nobles District of the Imperial City.
Captain Arakh is an Orsimer member of the Fighters Guild found at the Tower of Lies.
Captain Alcardawe is an Altmer soldier of the Dominion found at their base inside the Imperial City Sewers.
Captain Alphaury was a Breton member of the Fighters Guild. He was slain by Bosmers of the Shadow Walkers Clan when him and his team ventured into The Moonless Walk.
Calion's Husk is a Flesh Atronach that appears in . He is found in the Ossuary of Telacar, and was created by Telacar from the remains of his deceased son, Calion.
Calvus Marcrina is an Imperial slave found at the Velmont Mansion in Abah's Landing.
Caldelnalin is an Altmer residing in the Barracks House in Wayrest. He is sheltering from the Dreugh attack. He has no unique dialogue.
Capiton Sibylla is an Imperial found sweeping the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Caldien is a member of the Mages Guild. He and his team can be found taking part in the moot on the island of Stirk.
Calunorril is an Altmer traveling merchant who sells his wares on the road between Haven and Elden Root.
Calysa Dathieu is a Breton commoner residing in Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Captain Alesace is a Breton member of the Daggerfall Covenant. He is a quest giver at the Northern High Rock Gate, Cyrodiil.

Captain Jena Apinia, also known as the Butcher of Bravil is a captain of the Imperial Legion and considered a war criminal by the Aldmeri Dominion. She is located in Garlas Agea, with a small squad of her Legion soldiers.
Caesina Fontius is an Imperial merchant. She sells her wares at her stall, The Wonder Wagon, at the Trader's Circle in Kvatch.
Caldana Rulician is an Imperial member of the Order of the Hour. She is found at the Enclave of the Hourglass.
Captain Furia is an Imperial member of the Order of the Hour. She is found alongside Primate Artorius, where she acts as his bodyguard.

Canthion is a Bosmer in . Depending on the Vestige's alliance, he can be found at the Bank of Daggerfall in Daggerfall, Uveran Bank in Davon's Watch, the bank at the Vulkhel Guard Manor & Treasury in Vulkhel Guard, or at Lord Vivec's Vault in Lord Vivec's Vault in Vivec City. As of Update 16, this character no longer appears in the game.

Canon Llevule Andrano is a Dunmer canon of the Tribunal Temple initially found at Andrano Ancestral Tomb. As a member of the Temple, Llevule serves the Lord Vivec of the Tribunal, and is an aide to Archcanon Tarvus.
Captain Hler is a Dunmer sailor found at the Coastal Skiff in Vivec City. Captain Hler's boat offers transport to Mournhold. She offers no unique dialogue.
Captain Giravel is a Dunmer residing in Tel Aruhn, Vvardenfell, in .
Captain Brivan is a Dunmer soldier of House Redoran residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell, in . He is overseeing the House's attempts to locate Councilor Eris's missing daughter.

Camonna Tong Arbalests is a generic Dunmer arbalests residing in Khartag Point, Vvardenfell, in . This enemy is always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available Disguises that an be used to avoid combat with them.
Calysa Velain is a Breton drunkard found within Vivec City Furnishing in the Saint Delyn Waistworks in Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.
Captain Falcus is a captain that served in the Imperial Legion during Titus Mede I's reign.

Captain Arges was a Captain of the Imperial Legion during Titus Mede I's reign. He was the ranking officer that commanded the retreat of the Imperial forces from Cheydinhal to the Imperial City. His men had to escort the refugees that fled Cheydinhal after it was besieged by the undead forces of Umbriel.
Calvur was the head of the criminals that carried out Prince Attrebus' kidnapping.
Camaisse is an Altmer found at the northern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Calawende is an Altmer chief diplomat of the Mages Guild residing in Lillandril, Summerset.

Camoran Anaxemes was the Bosmer king of Valenwood in 2E 830, and a member of the Camoran Dynasty, who has ruled over the province for several years. Anaxemes was one of the heirs to vie for the throne in Falinesti. He had won it when he formed an alliance with the High King of Alinor, the province of the Summerset Isles. This alliance would become the Second Aldmeri Dominion.
Captain Brand is a Redguard member of the Iron Wheel residing in Hew's Bane.
Cainar is an Altmer mage who is trapped in K'Tora's mind trap along with his companion Miriya.
Campanus Tetius is an Imperial arena combatant in the Dragonwood Arena. He is also an Imperial Legion veteran.
Captain Hingrid is a Nord in residing in Dragon Bridge, Western Skyrim.
Captain Juras is an ex-Imperial Captain who was a friend of Nelerien, who was killed at Juras' Fall and now roams it. Nelerien asks the Vestige to lay him to rest.
Caldana Albarnian is an Imperial noble wandering Bog Brokers and High-End Furnishings in Lilmoth, Murkmire. She has no unique dialogue.
Captain Danylva is a Nord residing in the Palace of Kings in Eastmarch.
Cassynder Septim was the fourteenth ruler of the Third Empire of Tamriel.

Carecalmo is an Altmer mage, who operates out of the Daedric shrine Ashalmimilkala. In addition to Sithis, he also worships the Daedric Prince Mehrunes Dagon. He is helping the Dark Brotherhood (but is not a member of the faction) and is protected by his bodyguard Meryaran.

Caroline is a Breton living in Cloud Ruler Temple, and can most often be found guarding the front door during 4am to 12pm until she is relieved by Cyrus. She patrols the Inner Temple until 8pm and then eats dinner. She feels a deep sense of sorrow for her former emperor Uriel Septim VII dying before getting him to the temple. She wears a full set of Blades armor and wields a Akaviri Katana.
Carandial is an Altmer Mages Guild member who resides in Bravil.

Carmen Litte is a Redguard commoner and the wife of Alberic Litte, a Mages Guild member and trainer. She is not a member of the guild herself. She resides in Chorrol. She can often be found in the Chorrol Mages Guild hall conversing with her husband, or in the streets of Chorrol.
Captain Steffan is an Imperial Commander of the Blades at Cloud Ruler Temple in the absence of Grandmaster Jauffre.

Carmalo Truiand is an Imperial Watch Guard Captain. After Imperial Corruption, he can be found wandering the Market District in Audens Avidius' patrol. He is described as being "smart but inexperienced. A good second choice" when being appraised for the position of Captain of the Guard in Anvil.
Carius Runellius is a member of the Bruma City Guard. He is the chief investigator during the quest "A Brotherhood Betrayed." Carius is convinced Bradon Lirrian is a vampire.
Carodus Oholin is an Imperial crusader first met at the Chapel of Zenithar in Leyawiin.
Carsten is a Nord who stays at The Two Sisters Lodge in Skingrad. He and his colleagues Eridor, Shamar, and Vontus Idolus are all vampire hunters.
Cat-Face is an Argonian ostler who sells Paint Horses at the Five Riders Stables for 500 just to the north of Leyawiin. He hires Atahba to take care of the horses.

Captain Valmir is an undercover Thalmor agent disguised as a Stormcloak captain or an Imperial soldier, found camping on his own outside of Forelhost. He and Rahgot are the primary antagonists of the quest "Siege on the Dragon Cult."
Cargas Laftrius was an Imperial Fighters Guild member who was sent on a mission to Forsaken Mine to take out some trolls.
Carmana Sintav is an Imperial commoner and a member of the Sintav clan. She, like the other females in the clan, wears middle class clothing.
Cartrus Gavinius is an Imperial who is found dead in the Forsaken Mine.
Captive is a deceased Imperial found in . She is found in The Incautious Bather unmarked location, a watering hole near Druadach Redoubt.
Captain Rana is a Dunmer captain residing on Bleakrock Isle. She can be found in her office in Bleakrock Village and outside of Last Rest depending on what quests the Vestige has completed.
Carine Esmery is a Breton residing in the city of Daggerfall. She is typically found at the city's market, where she paces back and forth.
Captain Pennet is a Breton officer member of the Lion Guard residing in Aldcroft.
Captain Vistra is a Breton Captain of the Lion Guard, residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra.
Captain Seline was a Breton found in Carzog's Demise, Betnikh. She is one of the characters found in King Renwic's vision. She was captured by the Orsimers when they took over Betnikh.
Carth Northwind is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their guildhall in Mournhold.
Carena is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. She is found upstairs at the Crosswych Inn, cleaning the floor.

Captain Smagg is an Orsimer residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. Upon arrival, he can be found staying at the Sleepy Sailor Inn while waiting for repairs. His ship hit a rock, as the lighthouse was not working. He only wants to be back at sea. He can later be found on the docks with his ship repaired.
Cassandre Edilitte is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. She is found in their branch in Wayrest.
Captain Rahiba is a Khajiit member of the Mistral City Guard.
Cassirion is an Altmer residing in the city of Marbruk. He owns a house next to the city walls together with his wife Quertasse. He is usually drunk and can be encountered watching young women dance.
Captain Rawan is a Redguard found in Satakalaam and in Tava's Blessing, in the Alik'r Desert region.
Captain Valec Doronil is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed in Tal'Deic Fortress. He can also be found later nearby the Honrich Tower Wayshrine, during the quest, Shattered Hopes.

Captain Tendil is an Altmer captain in the First Auridon Marines. At different times, he is stationed in the towns of Skywatch and Silsailen. After completing "Teldur's End," he can be found in front of Valano Manor in Silsailen.
Captain al-Hallen is a Redguard warrior of the Ra Gada leading the attack on Velyn Harbor, with the help of the local Wood Orcs.
Captain at-Mardeen is a Redguard warrior and member of the Ra Gada. She is involved in the assault on Velyn Harbor.

Captain Mathias Etienne is the head of the Wayrest City Guard and the personal bodyguard of High King Emeric while he is in the capital. He is currently dealing with a local gang of bandits who are wreaking havoc in the city.
Captain Noris is a Dunmer soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found at their camp near Vivec's Antlers.
Captain Norra is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. She is currently trying to stop the flow of scamps that have recently been pouring out of Ash Mountain.
Captain Odreth is a Bosmer member of the Vinedusk Rangers. During the quest "Oath of Excision," he attempts to repel the assaulting Gold Coast Mercenaries away from Vinedusk Village.

Captain One-Eye is an Argonian pirate in first found in Alten Corimont where she tries to get rid of a Dominion spy running supply lines in the city. She is later found in Coldharbour, where she and her crew are searching for an ancient treasure supposedly located in The Lost Fleet.
Captain Parondo is the leader of the Sea Vipers forces trying to destroy the town of Greenwater Cove.
Captain Rela is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is found in the ruins of Quendeluun, where she is forming a secret alliance with the Veiled Heritance.
Captain Roreles is a powerful wraith boss in that resides inside Toadstool Hollow. Defeating Captain Roreles is part of the Toadstool Hollow Explorer achievement.
Captain Saril is a Dunmer member the House Indoril forces found in Kragenmoor. He is found inside the Grandmaster's Palace.
Captain Seritenya is an Altmer in who is found at the Ogrim's Yawn. Later she moves to the Jode's Pocket.
Captain Shammin is the Redguard leader of the Ra Gada pirates occupying Dead Man's Drop.
Captain Siro is an Imperial officer of the Seventh Legion. He has infiltrated the Crimson Raiders, a gang of pirates holed up in Crimson Cove.

Captain Taern is a Breton in acting as commander of King Ranser's guard. She fought with the King during King Ranser's War and can be seen during the vision of the final battle of Ranser at the Traitor's Tor.
Captain Thayer is a Breton recruiting officer for the Lion Guard. She is currently trying to enlist civilians from the town of Hoarfrost Downs to serve in the Shornhelm city guard.
Captain Trelano is the leader of the remaining Fists of Thalmor officers found in the Wilding Run.
Captain Usnagikh is the Orsimer leader of a local militia group set up at the Saltwalker Militia Camp.
Captain Vari Warhammer is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. She is sent as an envoy by Jorunn the Skald-King to alert the Vestige of the events taking place in Trolhetta.
Captain Venali is a Dunmer member of the House Indoril forces found in Kragenmoor. He is found patrolling their barracks in the city.

Captain Viveka is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. She is found at her camp located south of Wisplight Glen. She is tasked with tracking down Sinmur, a powerful giant who has allied himself with the reachmen.

Captain Wardush is an Orsimer soldier of the Daggerfall Covenant who faced the Seventh Legion at the Old Tower in the region of Bangkorai in . He has two sister-wives: Shagrum gra-Dumba and Shamush gra-Dumba.
Caragwen is an Altmer residing in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood.

Caravan Master Girano is a Dunmer noble of House Hlaalu who was running a caravan across Deshaan. He was ambushed by raiders of House Dres while passing by the ruins of Mzithumz and his cargo was stolen.
Caroline Acques is a Breton residing in the outlaws refuge in Shornhelm, Rivenspire.

Carrod is a Redguard member of Captain Currod's crew found aboard The Tava's Bounty, docked in Koeglin Village in Stormhaven. He has no unique dialogue, and can be found injured on the quarterdeck next to Krasdore.
Carterril is an Altmer traveling merchant found on the road north from Woodhearth.
Casnar at-Tarin is a Forebear who was supposed to wed a member of the Crowns, Tiela, but for unknown reasons, has not shown up to the wedding.
Casorlaure is an Altmer patron of the Salted Wings Tavern, Vulkhel Guard.
Cassia Varo is an Imperial and the leader of the Worm Cult cell found in Abamath.
Castewe is an Altmer clothier residing in the town of Haven, Grahtwood. She can be found at the Haven Foundry, selling her wares.

Cassyr Whitley was a Breton spy who infiltrated the Imperial Legion. He is most notable for infamously reporting the Legion's plans to the Dunmer during the Four Score War. This action greatly contributed to the Legion's complete slaughter in a Dunmer trap during their march on Morrowind in 1E 2920.
Captain Mulamurr is a Khajiit officer of the Dominion found at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate in .
Captain Sireril is an Altmer officer of the Dominion found at the Western Elsweyr Gate.
Caravaneer Iggistill is a traveling merchant found on the road east of Ebonheart or at Vivec's Antlers. He travels alongside Io-Io.
Caretaker Beldros is a Dunmer alchemist residing in Vivec City, Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue.
Caretaker Arethan is a Dunmer of House Redoran residing in their living quarters in Mournhold.
Caretaker Urnsi is a Dunmer of House Redoran. She resides inside their living quarters in Mournhold.
Captain Rulbza is an Orsimer found outside Frostbreak Fortress in Wrothgar.
Captain Zagla is an Orsimer outside Frostbreak Fortress in Wrothgar.

Captain Priscus is an Imperial Captain of the Imperial Legion. He is part of the squad guarding the bridge leading into the Imperial City. The soldiers under the command of Priscus are fighting the Daedra at the southern most bridge leading to the Imperial City.
Carmalo Hersus is an Imperial scholar residing inside his house in Anvil. He cannot be interacted with.
Carius Vandacia is an Imperial found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Carlotta Censorinus is an Imperial residing in Anvil. She is found fishing on the shore near the docks.
Captain Nieth is a Bosmer found in Anvil, Gold Coast. She can be seen at the eastern end of the docks.
Caretalker Ministe is an Imperial artisan found at the Colovian Revolt Forge Yard. She confuses the player for Emperor Varen and still believes that the Colovian revolt is ongoing.
Captain Virindi Slave-Taker is a Maormer pirate captain and the leader of the Keel Cutters, a gang of slavers found at Thrall Cove. She is a world boss.
Captain Virgilus is an Imperial Captain of the Imperial Legion. She is found guarding the easternmost bridge leading into the Imperial City.
Castor the Puzzlemaker's Corpse is a deceased Dunmer bandit wizard in . He is an unused character that carries a Steel Dagger and 25 .
Captain Netanwe is the Altmer captain of the mercenary group, tasked with keeping order in Phaer while it is under quarantine state.
Captain Velyna is an Altmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She can be found within the Ayleid ruins of Silyanorn.
Carpenter Curissil is an Altmer member of the Fist of Thalmor crew that has been taken hostage by the Sea Vipers camped at Jode's Pocket.
Caretaker Weedum-Ja is an Argonian priest found at Iliath Temple. She has no unique dialogue.

Caraleth is a Bosmer residing in Marbruk. She is one of the targets listed in the Litany of Blood. Between Driladan pass and Fighters guild. Like all targets, she has one white eye and must be killed with the Blade of Woe. She dissolves into a pool of blood when killed, though respawns almost immediately.
Captain Nyomie is a Breton and a member of the Evermore City Guard.
Captain Rhealt is a Breton member of the Daggerfall Covenant. She is found at the Lunar Fang Docks.
Caretaker Yvelle is a Breton priestess found in Iliath Temple.
Captain Rythe is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found at the Northern Morrowind Gate.
Caretaker Morusu is a Dunmer priestess found in Iliath Temple.
Caretaker Thelama is a Dunmer priestess found in Iliath Temple. She has no unique dialogue.
Cason Delvi is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Evermore.

Captain Regilus is an Imperial member of Legion Zero. He serves as a spy for the Drake of Blades. He is slowly decaying from the inside as he was forced to consume the Blood of Coldharbour when the daedra invaded the Imperial City, a substance causing him to progressively becoming mind-shriven. He eventually poisons himself to prevent becoming mind-shriven.
Captain Volso is an Imperial officer of the Legion of the West Weald. She is encountered inside the temple in Rawl'kha.

Cardea Gallus is an Imperial member of the Fighters Guild. She handles the Dark Anchors-related contracts for the guild and can be found in the guildhalls of the Fighters Guild in Elden Root, Mournhold, or Wayrest.
Carodus Atius is an Imperial member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Riften.
Castellan Condaris is an Imperial residing inside his house in Kvatch.
Captain Ululmalit is a Khajiit member of the Imperial Legion. He was the captain of Imperial City Prison Guard prior to the daedra invasion of the Imperial City.

Carmion is an Altmer found in the Gladiator's Assembly of Dragonstar Arena, in Craglorn. He is found on the north side of the room waiting to be called to compete in the arena with his partner, Kilisia.
Carwengil is a Bosmer sailor drinking in The Saucy Nix in Seyda Neen on Vvardenfell. She has no unique dialogue.
Captain Velendas is a Dunmer found at the Holamayan Monastery, Vvardenfell in .

Caretaker Sarathram is a Dunmer scholar residing in the city of Balmora, Vvardenfell. When not taking care of the vegetation in the northeast part of Balmora, he will take a break and sit on the nearby chair, studying his book. He has no unique dialogue.
Captain Zugnor is an Orsimer captain of the Orsinium city guard.
Carnirrimo is an Altmer noble residing in the Brass Fortress in the Clockwork City.

Captain Nulra is an Orsimer member of the Vosh Rakh met during the events of "The King's Gambit" in the ramparts of Orsinium. She holds the key to The Greedy Gut, and must then be defeated in order to obtain access to the Gut.
Villagers is a Breton found chained to a post in Viridian Watch. When the Vestige unchains them, they thank him and escape.
Captain Nala-do is a Khajiit found in the region of Northern Elsweyr.
Caravan Watchman is a Khajiit member of the Baandari Clan. He is found in their camp at the Martyr's Crossing. He cannot be interacted with.
Carmalo Nirol is an Imperial soldier who appears in Hakoshae in Northern Elsweyr.
Casta Tiragrius is an elderly Imperial residing in Hakoshae, Northern Elsweyr. He appears only at the end of "Descendant of the Potentate" in the crowd of people listening to Magnate Feina-Darak.
Captain Rythe is a Dunmer Ebonheart Pact officer at the Northern Morrowind Gate in Cyrodiil.
Captain Nahrevii is a Khajiit member of the Renrijra Maor residing in Sunscale Strand in Shadowfen.
Captain Mavvok is an Redguard in and captain of The Silver Cormorant in Western Skyrim.
Captain Saulinia is an Imperial in found at the Dov-Vahl Shrine in Northern Elsweyr. She is a leader in the Euraxian army bent on finding the last Dragonguard.
Casey Mongillo (born October 22, 1987) is an American voice performer who provided the voices for many characters in and for . __NOTOC__
Casta Acidinus is an Imperial noble in who resides at the Governor's Mansion in Gideon.
Captain Rian Liore is an Imperial captain of the Ivory Brigade in who resides outside of Leyawiin.

Castigator Athin is a Dunmer member of the Sixth House. She can be found in the western part of the Forgotten Depths of the Forgotten Wastes. Together with Coaxer Veran and Confessor Dradas, they are considered a boss of the dungeon.

Captain Samara is a Khajiit residing outside of Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr, in . She a captain in the Elsweyr Defense Force and leads a training program for Dragon-slaying with her second-in-command Apprentice Taz. Samara wields a two handed greatsword with medium armor in the Dragonguard Style.

Captain Shideya is a Khajiit member of the Elsweyr Defense Force responsible for training the Forces' recruits in fighting various creatures. The Vestige can assist her in various locations around Tamriel after completing the quest "The Halls of Colossus."
The Captured Soldier is an Imperial located in Arenthia, Reaper's March, in . He is a Colovian soldier who has been captured by the resistance fighters.
Captain Vrol is a Sea Giant that appears in . He serves as the second boss of Kyne's Aegis.
Captain Marie Elena is an Imperial residing in the Enclave of the Hourglass. She is seeking to join the Order of the Hour.
The Captive Spirit, known as the Ancient Spirit before capture, is a Dunmer Ghost residing in Valenvaryon in Vvardenfell.
Capucine is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, located inside the Old Goat Inn.

Cephorus Septim II was the sixteenth monarch of the Third Empire of Tamriel. He was voted into power by the Elder Council in 3E 247, weeks after the death of his cousin and predecessor, Uriel Septim IV.

Chana Mona is Mara's Primate in Bravil's Great Chapel of Mara. She takes care of the chapel's affairs and speaks on behalf of the goddess Mara in the Council of the Nine. Because Uravasa Othrelas and Marz do most of the duties, Chana is able to spend more time to devote to her own faith.
Caula Allectus is an Imperial commoner residing in the Imperial City, Temple District with her husband Amantius Allectus, who is the subject of the Thieves Guild quest "May the Best Thief Win."
Cavortius Albuttian is an Imperial living in Ebonheart. He is also second-in-command of the Imperial Legion in Vvardenfell.
Chanil-Lee is an Argonian living in Ebonheart. She is also a Journeyman of the Mages Guild and a minor trainer in Destruction, Enchant, and Mysticism.
Cedran is a Breton stable owner living outside Markarth's walls. He is the owner of the Markarth Stables, and he will sell his Pinto horse for 1000 .

The Champion of Boethiah once existed to serve the mighty Daedric Prince, Boethiah. He has outlived his usefulness and uses the Ebony Mail bestowed upon him for his own pleasure rather than Boethiah's, which has angered the Daedric Prince. He now leads a group of Bandits out of Knifepoint Ridge and resides within Knifepoint Mine.
Celegorn is a Bosmer thief in who resides in Dirty Muriel's Cornerclub, near Wolverine Hall and Sadrith Mora.

Catchica was an Orma tribeswoman who lived during the late First Era. She appears in the book series 2920, The Last Year of the First Era. She is known to have been in Caer Suvio before the Battle of Bodrum took place.
